description: OpenAI research indicates that 70% of ChatGPT messages are not work-related.

instances.assertion: OpenAI research indicates that 70% of ChatGPT messages are not work-related.
Research indicates that AI models can exhibit 'emergent' abilities that are not present in smaller models and cannot be predicted by simple extrapolation.
Research indicates that current machine unlearning methods are often ineffective at completely removing specific information from large language model weights.
